Builder’s coordinates

The 20 × 13.5 body begins at (0, 1.5) in the 20 × 15 inventory. Keep the existing navigation and call the Account page with the inventory grid hidden. The table uses body-local real units. Label y is its midline, w its measured text advance, and h is zero because labels size themselves.

Implementation notes
  • Draw each image and flat box in order. Emit panel backgrounds before foreground elements. Use the shared button role styles and restore scoped label styles. Arimo is rasterized at a 21 px reference size per 64 px unit. Apply the inventory’s fitted text scale in game.
  • Use the catalogue for each known ID’s icon, name, kind and use hint. Read advertised IDs only from the website’s list. Read owned IDs only from the linked account. The three- and four-item previews use a hypothetical website configuration. Unknown IDs drop out. A missing list omits the whole shelf.
  • The Charter stacks advertised rewards on the left. Village Road gives each reward 4.6 units across. Both fit four at once. For a longer owned list, repeat Charter rows at a 2.38-unit pitch or Village Road rows two across below the banner. Use a native scroll container in the collection space above the fixed help row. Keep backgrounds outside the scroller.
  • Fit account and character names within their title rectangles. Use wrapped, escaped prose or a measured ellipsis and a full-name tooltip. Keep the link offer’s complete account name readable before confirmation.
  • The code field and Enter both use the existing check, offer and confirmation flow. Start on the existing neutral focus target. Preserve the typed code on refusal. Keep actions inert in place while checking or confirming and put the current status beside them. Character creation keeps its existing one-line gate.
  • The website control maps to button_url with the visible address as a manual fallback. Only a website administrator unlinks a character.
Existing art & credits

The Charter uses the approved Grudgelands crest by Jan Hangebrauck (CC0 1.0). Village Road crops the shipped human character-creation scene with a fixed texture crop. Its arrangement is by the Grudgelands project, CC BY-SA 3.0. The original blocks, plants and props retain their component licences. The build uses the original inventory faction mark, UI plates and catalogue icons. Both layouts need zero new art.

Cheer uses the player model by MirceaKitsune and contributors, with the Grudgelands skin, pose and render (CC BY-SA 3.0). The cloak designs, heraldic tab mark and UI theme are Grudgelands artwork (CC0 1.0). The crest and icon proportions are preserved. The village crop uses the original pixels scaled to the banner. Arimo is by The Noto Project Authors (SIL OFL 1.1).
